PluginData.Author: Taeleus
PluginData.Tooltip: Link your welder, grinder and drill to an owned or faction-shared inventory.
PluginData.Description:
Connect your welder, grinder or drill to an owned or faction-shared inventory. Welders pull build-planner components through normal conveyor access; grinders and drills send materials back.
Transfers work inside the selected grid's bounds, pause outside, and break more than 100 m beyond them. Enemy grids overlapping the bounds also block tethering.
Ship damage, weapon fire and supported EMP/jump-inhibition effects cause a two-minute cooldown across mechanical and docked grids. Player bump damage and your own grinding do not count. An isolated connector hit is tolerated; repeated damage or destruction still counts. Newly observed grids and WeaponCore weapons need two minutes of observation. Cooldowns survive reconnects.
Supports vanilla weapons, WeaponCore and optional Vanilla+ effects. No server mod required.
/tether - connect /tether off - disconnect /tether bounds - toggle bounds /tether bounds off - hide bounds
